eval: document.getElementById('nameInput').value = 'Boss'; document.getElementById('playBtn').click(); 'joined'
dp.net.send({t: 'rules', reset: true}); 'rules reset to the defaults'
['botsRedPlus', 'botsRedPlus', 'botsBluePlus', 'winPlus', 'winPlus'].forEach((id) => document.getElementById(id).click()); 'RED bots +2, BLUE bots +1, match length +2'
document.getElementById('skillSelect').value = 'hard'; document.getElementById('skillSelect').dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); 'skill hard'

JSON.stringify({red: document.getElementById('botsRedValue').textContent, blue: document.getElementById('botsBlueValue').textContent, win: document.getElementById('winValue').textContent, players: dp.net.latest.players.size, summary: document.getElementById('rulesSummary').textContent, note: document.getElementById('teamsNote').textContent})

document.getElementById('rulesBtn').click(); const s = document.getElementById('rulesSearch'); s.value = 'perfect'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelectorAll('#rulesList .rule').length + ' rules match "perfect"'

(() => { const ed = dp.editor; ed.setDraft('GRAVITY', 3); ed.setDraft('WALK_SPEED', 9); const n = ed.edits().length; document.getElementById('rulesRevert').click(); const after = ed.edits().length; document.getElementById('rulesResetAll').click(); return JSON.stringify({edits: n, afterUndo: after, afterResetAll: ed.edits().length, botsDraft: [ed.draft.BOTS_RED, ed.draft.BOTS_BLUE]}); })()

(() => { document.getElementById('rulesRevert').click(); const q = document.getElementById('rulesSearch'); q.value = ''; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const ed = dp.editor; ed.group = 'assist'; ed.renderNav(); ed.renderList(); ed.setFocus('SLOW_BALL_CURVE'); ed.setDraft('SLOW_BALL_CURVE', 0.2); return document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent + ' | ' + document.getElementById('previewText').textContent; })()
(() => { const ed = dp.editor; ed.group = 'ricochet'; ed.renderNav(); ed.renderList(); ed.setFocus('RICOCHET_CURVE_KEEP'); return document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent; })()
document.getElementById('rulesRevert').click(); document.getElementById('rulesClose').click(); 'editor closed'

dp.input.onPress('deflect'); dp.input.onPress('deflect'); JSON.stringify({popup: document.getElementById('popups').textContent, logged: dp.diag.lines.filter((l) => l.ty === 'ignored').map((l) => l.a)})
dp.net.send({t: 'rules', set: {LOCKOUT_SCALE: 0}}); 'lockout after a missed press: 0'

(() => { const ignored = dp.diag.lines.filter((l) => l.ty === 'ignored').length; const presses = dp.diag.lines.filter((l) => l.ty === 'press').length; dp.input.onPress('deflect'); dp.input.onPress('catch'); return JSON.stringify({newPresses: dp.diag.lines.filter((l) => l.ty === 'press').length - presses, newIgnored: dp.diag.lines.filter((l) => l.ty === 'ignored').length - ignored, action: dp.local.action}); })()
JSON.stringify({busyDenies: dp.diag.lines.filter((l) => l.ty === 'ev' && l.k === 'deny' && l.why === 'busy').length})

dp.net.send({t: 'rules', set: {LOCKOUT_SCALE: 1}}); (() => { const ed = dp.editor; document.getElementById('rulesBtn').click(); ed.group = 'network'; ed.renderNav(); ed.renderList(); ed.setFocus('PRESS_GRACE'); ed.setDraft('PRESS_GRACE', 0.04); return [...document.querySelectorAll('#rulesList .rule')].map((r) => r.dataset.key).join(', ') + ' | ' + document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent; })()

(() => { const ed = dp.editor; ed.replaceDraft({ ...ed.base() }); ed.setFocus('SIDESTEP_COMP'); ed.setDraft('SIDESTEP_COMP', false); return document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent + ' | ' + document.getElementById('previewText').textContent; })()
(() => { const ed = dp.editor; ed.replaceDraft({ ...ed.base() }); ed.setFocus('LOCKOUT_SCALE'); ed.setDraft('LOCKOUT_SCALE', 0); return document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent; })()
document.getElementById('rulesRevert').click(); document.getElementById('rulesClose').click(); 'editor closed'

dp.showMenu(); document.getElementById('botsBlueMinus').click(); 'fewer BLUE bots mid-match'

JSON.stringify({blue: document.getElementById('botsBlueValue').textContent, soon: document.getElementById('botsBlueSoon').textContent, pending: document.getElementById('pendingText').textContent, players: dp.net.latest.players.size, title: document.getElementById('overlayTitle').textContent})
document.getElementById('discardBtn').click(); 'discard'

document.getElementById('shuffleBtn').click(); document.getElementById('endBtn').click(); JSON.stringify({armed: document.getElementById('endBtn').textContent, state: dp.net.latest.r.s})
document.getElementById('endBtn').click(); 'confirmed'

JSON.stringify({state: dp.net.latest.r.s, status: document.getElementById('menuStatus').textContent, bots: [dp.rules.active.BOTS_RED, dp.rules.active.BOTS_BLUE], watchers: document.getElementById('watchers').textContent, button: document.getElementById('watchBtn').textContent, resume: document.getElementById('resumeBtn').textContent})
